condition.help: Use this condition to apply a partial pressure for each gas and keep it constant during the analysis. Gas concentrations will adjust to maintain the partial pressure as temperature changes

value.help: Curve from the Time functions container that drives the PARTIAL PRESSURE of gas 1 in time. Constant holds the value above for the whole calculation. The concentration at the node is recomputed every step as p/(R T), so the curve drives the partial pressure and the concentration follows the temperature.
